text:
Happy Wednesday! We're starting in the 30s with a bit of frost on the windshield, but plenty of sunshine takes over today and pushes us to a high near 57. That's about 10 degrees above normal for mid-November. Tonight stays partly cloudy and settles to around 38.

Thursday looks a whole lot like today: mostly sunny, high near 57. Some of the models and TV forecasters flirt with 60, so I'd lean toward the warmer side of mid to upper 50s. Thursday night is milder, only dropping to around 42, and clouds may thicken a bit heading into Friday.

The air quality is Moderate this morning from fine particle pollution. It's fine for most of us, but if you're sensitive, take it easy outside.

Enjoy the stretch, because it ends Sunday night into Monday. The forecasters are split on whether a few light showers or something wetter arrives, and I'd bet on the lighter side here. Either way, highs fall to the mid 30s to low 40s by Tuesday. Today is the day for the long walk.

week.blurb: Sunny and mild this afternoon with a high near 57, then a clear, chilly evening with lows near 38.
Another mostly sunny, mild day near 57, though the models run a few degrees apart, so 55 to 59 is fair.
Sunny and dry again with a high near 57, and a mild night ahead with lows only around 42.
Saturday looks sunny and dry with a high near 57, a great day to get outside, with a breeze picking up by evening.
Mostly sunny and mild near 56, but a breezy south wind gusts to 25 mph, with a few showers possible after 1am.
Looks like a cooler, mostly cloudy day near 49 with a slight chance of rain, then a cold night dropping toward 29.
Trending much colder: partly sunny with a high only near 37 and a brisk northwest breeze, so bundle up.
